messages:
olivia: Quick q for the release crew — before Thursday's change window can we agree a tighter rule for when to bump patch vs minor? I want fewer surprise client rollouts.
raj: yes please. current ambiguity around infra-only vs deps-only is causing churn.
tess: my take: patch for bugfixes + non-behavioral deps (build/test tools), minor for public behavior or contract changes. config-only? patch.
marc: +1. also: if a change touches any exported SDK surface -> minor.
olivia: that seems reasonable. what about deploy-bot automation? should it auto-bump patch on merges to main that match a label?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot here — we can auto-bump semantic version on merge if the PR has one of: [patch], [minor], or [no-bump]. Current default = no-bump.
raj: hmm default no-bump is safe but encourages manual mistakes. maybe require explicit label for minor, auto patch for CI-only tidy commits?
sarah: suggestion: label rules: [chore] or docs -> no bump; [deps] or [ci] -> patch; [fix] -> patch; [feat] or any API change -> minor.
tess: I still worry about infra changes that are invisible to SDKs but break runtimes (eg config toggles). Those should be patch but flagged in release notes.
marc: we should also add a lightweight checklist in PR template: 'Does this change affect public contract? yes/no' to avoid noisy debates.
olivia: agreed. lets add rule: deps that only update devDependencies -> patch; runtime deps -> patch + callout in release notes if risky.
raj: what about tagging conventions? vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH vs including buildmeta like +deploy123. I prefer v1.3.2+ci.456 for internal-only builds.
sarah: keep canonical tag as v1.3.2 for git / changelog. append buildmeta on CI artifacts only (not git tag). simpler for rollbacks.
marc: rollback playbook reminder: if rollback within window, revert tag + push new patch bump with reason. we should avoid rewriting tags.
olivia: yes — forbid force-updating tags. always create new patch tag for rollback (eg v1.3.2 -> v1.3.3 rollback).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window opens Thu 02:00 UTC. current release candidate: v1.3.2-rc.1.
raj: can we add a stanza in deploybot that blocks release if PRs touching sdk/ or public/ don't have the 'public-impact' checkbox answered?
tess: I can add that to the PR template today.
olivia: ok action items: tess add checkbox + PR template tweak; sarah update label->bump mapping in release docs; marc update rollback playbook to forbid tag rewriting; raj follow up on deploy-bot auto-bump policy. We'll reconvene Wed morning. :thumbsup:
